submission.justification:
Radiator-R3 at 3 cm thickness provides the best pion/kaon separation performance at 10 GeV/c with 4.6 sigma separation. This is significantly superior to R2 (3.8 sigma at 3 cm) and R1 (2.9 sigma at 3 cm). 

The optimization study across multiple thicknesses for R3 shows that 3 cm is optimal, with separation values of: 2.5 cm = 4.587 sigma, 3.0 cm = 4.6 sigma, and 3.5 cm = 4.499 sigma. The 3 cm thickness represents the peak performance.

All three radiator candidates pass the critical ageing test requirement (transparency loss < 10% after 10-year-equivalent humidity exposure), so the selection is based purely on maximizing separation performance, which clearly favors R3 at 3 cm thickness.
